## Summary

<!-- What changed and why. -->

## Change control

<!-- Completed for every change so reviewers and auditors can see what was assessed. -->

- **Change type:** <!-- feature / fix / config / dependency / infra / docs -->
- **Linked ticket or incident:**
- **Customer or production impact:** <!-- none / describe; note any migration, flag or downtime -->
- **Rollback plan:** <!-- how to revert, and how long it takes -->

### Security and data impact

- [ ] No new secrets, tokens or credentials in code, config or logs
- [ ] Authentication, authorization and tenant scoping reviewed where this touches data access
- [ ] No new personal data collected or sent to a third party (or the privacy docs and sub-processor list are updated)
- [ ] New dependencies are maintained and free of known vulnerabilities
- [ ] Not applicable: documentation or tooling change only

### Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated and passing locally
- [ ] Reviewed by a person other than the author before merge
